videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video subtitle in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences capturing the key points.

2. Foreign media (Wall Street Journal, Axios, Financial Times, Guardian) reported urgently on this
3. WSJ pointed out basic security management failures (former employee kept access keys after resignation)
4. Axios noted Silicon Valley investors claim Korean government is targeting Coupang discriminatorily, could escalate to national dispute
5. FT mentioned US government views foreign regulations as non-tariff trade barriers, showing trade risks for US companies
6. Guardian analyzed this could burden Korea-US relations beyond just a corporate security incident
7. Some US Congress members questioning Korean government's investigation
8. Concerns about escalating to Korea-US conflict due to Coupang's lobbying activities in US political circles
9. Korean government plans to explain to US government to prevent diplomatic conflict
